TEMPEST MAN · ARENA FURNITURE 1 · WAVE 07, 12 VARIANTS BY ANATOMY (01 TO 12)

THE 12 VARIANTS REDONE, ONE FOR EACH NAMED PART OF A SURFING WAVE, TOP TO BOTTOM: PEAK, BREAK POINT, CREST, LIP, CURL, SPRAY, BARREL, FACE, SHOULDER, TROUGH, BASE, WHITEWATER. THESE ARE BUILT ON MY OWN OUTLINE, DRAWN BEFORE YOUR PAINT-OVER ARRIVED. THE FIRST PICTURE IS THAT OUTLINE WITH NOTHING CHANGED.

MY OUTLINE DIFFERS FROM YOUR PAINT-OVER IN THREE WAYS: ITS PEAK IS A POINT, NOT YOUR ROUND TOP; IT HAS FOAM ALL ALONG THE CREST AND UP THE BACK, NOT ONLY AFTER THE APEX; AND THE HOLLOW'S FRONT IS A FALLING CURTAIN OF SPRAY, NOT YOUR LINE FROM THE TIP BACK TO THE FOOT. SAY IF YOU WANT THESE 12 REDONE ON YOUR PICTURE INSTEAD. ALL PLAY 8 FRAMES OF 4 STEPS EACH, TWICE LIFE SIZE. THE SPEED BUTTON PLAYS THEM AT FULL, HALF OR QUARTER SPEED; STEP +1 PAUSES AND MOVES ON BY ONE STEP (1/60 S) EACH TAP. AFTER HOKUSAI'S GREAT WAVE (1831). NOTHING HERE IS IN THE GAME YET.
